// why: Type-checks main.js, the part of the mod that uses Herdr, and the modules it imports.
Herdr writes the type files it needs (gpui-kit.d.ts, herdr.d.ts) into its own folder on
every start, to match that version, and they must not be committed. bin/typecheck-herdr
copies them into .herdr-types/ first, and skips this check where Herdr isn't installed,
such as on GitHub's CI. skipLibCheck: Herdr's type files are not ours to fix.
strictPropertyInitialization is off: a Herdr view sets its fields in init(), which runs
after the view is made, and TypeScript only counts fields set in a constructor. Every
other strict check, null checks included, stays on.
